dependencies.units: Model: configured comparison predicates, including section/COI expressions. Export: state objects on all recursive components; a state can combine several predicates. Rule evidence and COI policy metadata take precedence over field origin. Missing legacy evidence is unverified. COI expressions without a policy marker follow their declared node origin. Manual rules are separate from source and standard policy. Static readOnly and unconditional flow links are not dynamic states.
